title: Frappe ERPNext 14.0.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 14.0.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Utilities module endpoint. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including portal users without roles, to retry failed bulk transactions without proper role checks. Exploitation can remove failed transactions from the normal recovery process and increase background job load on the system.
